description: This Java source file defines the class JsLanguageFileMappingCreator, which generates a mapping of locale-specific JavaScript language files for various JavaScript plugins (like date, validation, datetimepicker, select2) used in the OFBiz framework. It creates or updates a Java class with mappings to the correct locale files based on the available locale data and a specified template.

classes.name: JsLanguageFileMappingCreator
classes.description: A utility class responsible for creating or updating JavaScript language file mappings based on available locales, writing the generated mappings to a Java source file.

methods.name: createJsLanguageFileMapping
methods.description: Main method that gathers locale-specific file paths for various JavaScript plugins, applies fallbacks, and generates a Java class file using a FreeMarker template.
